psychological_meaning: Turquoise Blue combines the tranquility of blue with the growth aspects of green, offering a balance of calmness and invigoration. It is often associated with open communication, clarity of thought, and emotional balance. This color promotes creativity and inspiration, encouraging a sense of peace and well-being.
